# Security policy

## Supported version

Security fixes target the current `main` branch and the production deployment at <https://orenda-cherepashka-live.pages.dev/>. Older local copies and legacy demo deployments are not maintained.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please use [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting form](https://github.com/anton5267/orenda-cherepashka/security/advisories) and select **Report a vulnerability**. Do not open a public issue or post exploit details in a pull request.

Include the affected route or component, impact, steps to reproduce, and a minimal proof of concept. Do not include passwords, API tokens, customer records, or other people's personal data. The maintainers will review the report privately and coordinate a fix and disclosure through the security advisory.

For ordinary bugs or feature requests that do not expose a security issue, use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/anton5267/orenda-cherepashka/issues).
